settings.final_title: Give them the feeling of being remembered.
settings.final_body: Eight companions, including the favorite that made you think of them.

settings.personality_body: Maybe it is the charcoal hood or the pink ribbons. Recognizing that favorite turns a collection into a personal gesture, without needing to choose just one.
